entities.summary: Anna Nikitichna Mikhalkova is a Russian actress, film producer, cameraman, TV presenter; Merited Artist of the Russian Federation (2019). She is a member of the All-Russian public organization Union of Cinematographers of the Russian Federation in Moscow.
